Thank you for updating the documentation links. Most of the changes are correct and accurately reflect Canonical's current web properties and documentation locations (such as the migration to `canonical.com` domain structures). However, one of the updates actually introduces a broken link to the `iptables` documentation. Please see the inline comments for details.

docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md.425: Since this link now points to an internal page within the documentation repository, you might consider simplifying the link text to just `[How to Manage Machines](/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md)` to avoid redundancy with the 'MAAS Documentation \-' prefix.

docs/reference/configuration-guides/logg.16: The previous URL for the `iptables` documentation (`https://help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo`) was actually correct. The Ubuntu Community Help Wiki is hosted at `help.ubuntu.com/community/`, whereas `wiki.ubuntu.com` is generally reserved for Ubuntu development, teams, and specs. There is no `IptablesHowTo` page on `wiki.ubuntu.com`, so this change will result in a broken link. Please revert this specific URL change.
